tests.name: Negative numbers
tests.hint: Start the dict with {0: 1} so subarrays starting at index 0 count.

tests.name: Random small
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(560)
cases = [([random.randint(-3, 3) for _ in range(random.randint(1, 15))], random.randint(-3, 3)) for _ in range(50)]
tests.expr: [subarray_sum(a, k) for a, k in cases]
